bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/create-videobot
echo CREATEVDO_PREFLIGHT
if test -d "$repo/.git" || test -f "$repo/.git"; then
 echo "HEAD=$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse HEAD)"
 echo "BRANCH=$(git -C "$repo" branch --show-current)"
 echo "DIRTY=$(test -n "$(git -C "$repo" status --porcelain)" && echo YES || echo NO)"
else echo "REPO_NOT_FOUND"; fi
echo "CONTAINER=$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Status}}' gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1 2>/dev/null || echo UNKNOWN)"
echo "IMAGE=$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1 2>/dev/null || echo UNKNOWN)"
echo "USERBOT=$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service 2>/dev/null || true)"
echo CREATEVDO_PREFLIGHT_END
